units: tenths of a degree, sidereal (Lahiri), 00:00 UT
record: <9H (9 uint16 little-endian per day, in bodies order)
note: Browser-side birth-chart ephemeris. Slow bodies interpolate cleanly; the Moon is linear-interpolated and births within 0.5 deg of a nakshatra boundary are flagged near-a-cusp rather than forced.
